'''Steven Lewis Steven Sucks At TRs (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Steven Lewis]] posted on DeckTech on 24 September 2001 about [[September 2001 Nashville tournament]].<ref name="tr-d2988">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-steven-sucks-at-trsd2988/ steven-sucks-at-trs], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 24 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-24-steven-sucks-at-trsd2988/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Steven Lewis went 3–1 at a tournament around September 2001 that the report does not name or place, beating Jon Chu and two others and losing his last game to Brian Rippetoe's Profit insert deck.

== Original report ==

'''steven-sucks-at-trs'''
* '''Author:''' Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis
* '''Published:''' Sep 24, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  SO I tried to write this freakin’thing twice now and it screwed up both times so I give up.  Basically for anyone who is still interested, I went 3-1 and lost my last game to Brian Rippetoe’s chesse Profit insert deck.  I beat Jon Chu and two random guys.  Thanks for reading and maybe next time I try to write a TR it won’t screw up.



Steven "Technology Illiterate" Lewis
</nowiki></div>
